summary.text: Jay Case, a Republican, has represented District 63 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since January 9, 2013, and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Before serving in the General Assembly, he was a small business owner in northwest Connecticut, and he has also worked as a commercial energy consultant and in the construction industry.
District 63 includes Winchester, Colebrook, and sections of Goshen and Torrington.
